title: Personal Credit Cards: Late Fee and Returned Payment Fee Amounts
content:
These are the amounts, by tier of Personal Credit Cards, for the fee charged when a statement's minimum payment is missed and for the fee charged when a payment comes back unpaid. The late fee has a lower first amount and a higher repeat amount, chosen by looking back over a set number of earlier statement cycles.

| Tier | Late fee when no earlier late fee is found in the look-back | Late fee when an earlier late fee is found in the look-back | Statement cycles looked back over | Returned payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 29.00 USD | 40.00 USD | 6 | 29.00 USD |
| College Rewards Visa | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 6 | 25.00 USD |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 | 32.00 USD |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 | 32.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 | 32.00 USD |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 | 32.00 USD |

## Basis Q&A

- **Does College Rewards Visa distinguish a repeat late fee?** Its first and repeat amounts are the same, so the look-back never changes the figure on that tier.
- **Which cycles make up the look-back?** The six statement cycles immediately before the cycle being billed.

> Hypothetical illustration: a Platinum Low Rate Visa cardholder misses a minimum payment, and a late fee billed four cycles earlier still stands unreversed; the amount is the repeat figure of 41.00 USD. Had that earlier fee been reversed, or had it fallen seven cycles back, the first figure of 32.00 USD would apply.
